meta.title: He Shen Desktop Pet
meta.description: A chibi Qing official living in his own transparent window: click him for bows, drag to fling him, right-click for chat / treasury / deficit threshold / memory ledger, and fling him into a dsh-pet "big fat fish" to net her. Chat really calls a model with your DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (three-layer memory, token accounting); when the balance drops below the deficit threshold (10 CNY by default) he changes into his jail look. Disabling the plugin removes the window, the tray icon and the hedaren_pet tool.
